summary: Technical case report describing forensic traces consistent with use of a Cellebrite exploit chain against the phone of a Serbian student activist while detained.
relevance: Connects the Serbia case to a documented surveillance-forensics methodology while keeping the publisher's attribution, scope, and withheld exploit detail explicit.
verification_notes: Live Amnesty Security Lab report verified title, date, case scope, forensic timeline, vendor response context, and the authors' disclosure limits.

technical_profile.geographic_resolution: Single documented device and detention context
validation_requirements: Treat findings as the publisher's forensic conclusions and compare disclosed artifacts, patches, vendor statements, and any independent review.
limitations: Single-case scope does not establish prevalence; some exploit details were withheld pending patches; device traces cannot answer every legal-authorization question.
The atlas records Amnesty's forensic finding and does not independently re-examine the device.

safety_profile.display_note: Do not publish raw device artifacts, identifying timelines, exploit details withheld for patching, or information that could expose the affected person.

title: Methods
summary: Human-rights investigation methodology covering collection, immutable preservation, hashing, audit logs, tagging, source/content/technical analysis, and incident-level research.
relevance: Adds a mature end-to-end model for turning unstable public content into reviewable evidence without confusing preservation with verification.
verification_notes: Live Mnemonic methodology page verified title, date, public methods, Diwan and Elfehrest roles, principles, and acknowledged access limits.

signals: Source, content, location, time, and event analyses
technical_profile.geographic_resolution: Record, incident, event, and program archive
technical_profile.temporal_resolution: Acquisition, upload, content, and incident times kept distinct where known
validation_requirements: Use multimodal verification, reproducible notes, competing hypotheses, and clear separation of source, content, and technical analysis.
limitations: The public page does not expose all internal handbook procedures; archives face platform removal, collection gaps, and security-based access controls.
Archival integrity and traceability support later analysis but do not by themselves prove the depicted event or responsibility.

safety_profile.display_note: Preservation can expose victims, witnesses, source accounts, and investigators; access control and data minimization are part of evidentiary quality.

title: Using metadata to prove the reliability and validity of footage
summary: Explainer on controlled capture, multi-source metadata, hashing, encryption, secure transmission, and maintaining a reviewable custody record.
relevance: Distinguishes file integrity and custody from the separate work of corroborating context, identity, and events outside the frame.
verification_notes: Official eyeWitness pages verified the app and server workflow, metadata and chain-of-custody purpose, and limits of technology without legal and human review; no publication date was stated.

technical_profile.geographic_resolution: Individual capture event; location metadata where available and intentionally retained
validation_requirements: Compare metadata sources and hashes, corroborate location and time independently, and preserve the server-side custody record.
limitations: Metadata can be missing or inconsistent; capture integrity does not prove every contextual claim or material outside the frame.
A controlled capture workflow supports authenticity and custody but does not guarantee legal admissibility or contextual truth.

safety_profile.display_note: Original capture metadata can expose exact locations, devices, documenters, and witnesses; do not publish it merely because it aids verification.

title: Tella
summary: Open-source, multilingual documentation application for capturing and protecting sensitive media and structured records in low-connectivity or repressive environments.
relevance: Adds an evidence-collection tool while keeping encryption, hidden storage, offline transfer, verification, and legal admissibility as distinct claims.
verification_notes: Live official page verified project ownership, encryption and hidden-storage claims, offline-first transfer, integrations, languages, open-source code, and published audits; no publication date was stated.

technical_profile.geographic_resolution: User-selected case or record; metadata behavior depends on configuration and version
technical_profile.temporal_resolution: Capture and submission events where retained
validation_requirements: Retain originals, record application version and configuration, and perform independent media and contextual verification.
limitations: The landing page does not establish universal chain of custody, legal admissibility, metadata reliability, or safety under every threat model.
Encrypted capture protects a workflow component; it does not independently authenticate every claim or preserve a legal chain of custody.

safety_profile.display_note: Hidden or encrypted content can still create physical and legal risk if a device is discovered; local threat modelling and data minimization remain necessary.

title: Proofmode
summary: Open-source capture and verification ecosystem for inspecting and packaging media provenance, signatures, timestamps, and metadata.
relevance: Adds provenance tooling while explicitly preventing the common mistake of equating a valid signature or metadata field with verified event context.
verification_notes: Live official About page verified Capture and Verify workflow, metadata formats, source-code claims, privacy controls, and collaboration history; no publication date was stated.

technical_profile.geographic_resolution: Individual file and any intentionally included location claims
validation_requirements: Verify signatures and provenance, then separately assess source, content, location, chronology, and context.
limitations: Missing provenance proves nothing; valid provenance does not independently prove context, accuracy, location, or depicted events.
Provenance is a trust signal, not a truth verdict; public derivatives may need metadata redaction while originals remain protected.
Chain-of-custody features apply when Proofmode Capture's protected bundle and procedural handling are used, not to arbitrary third-party files inspected in Verify.

safety_profile.display_note: Location, device, and identity metadata can help verification while endangering documenters and subjects; preserve it under access control.

title: Content Credentials: C2PA Technical Specification
publisher: Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity
summary: Technical standard for cryptographically bound provenance manifests, assertions, signatures, hard and soft content bindings, and validation of Content Credentials.
relevance: Provides the technical layer behind several provenance tools while explicitly stating that validated provenance is not a value judgment about truth.
verification_notes: Live official version 2.4 specification and C2PA guiding principles were checked; the specification page did not provide a publication date suitable for the record.

validation_requirements: Validate the manifest and binding, assess signer trust and assertion meaning, and corroborate the underlying content and context independently.
limitations: A valid manifest establishes association and tamper evidence for assertions; it does not determine whether an assertion or depicted event is true, complete, or harmless.
Content Credentials can be absent, removed, incomplete, or signed by an untrusted actor and do not replace contextual verification.

safety_profile.display_note: Provenance assertions may expose creator, device, workflow, or location information; implementations should minimize data and model misuse.

title: Bellingcat's Online Investigation Toolkit
summary: Continuously maintained directory and review layer for mapping, satellite, image, video, web, social, archiving, and data-analysis tools.
relevance: Helps investigators find candidate methods while making clear that directory inclusion is not validation and each third-party tool has separate limits and terms.
verification_notes: Live official toolkit verified categories, community-maintenance model, staff review, downloadable index, work-in-progress status, and tool-specific limitation notes.

technical_profile.temporal_resolution: Entries have individual update state where available
validation_requirements: Use the directory to generate a method choice, then validate the selected tool, inputs, outputs, terms, and result independently.
limitations: Third-party tools change or disappear; coverage is incomplete; inclusion does not validate a tool or its output.
Tool-assisted observations remain hypotheses until reproduced, corroborated, and documented with confidence and rejected alternatives.

safety_profile.display_note: Do not use people-search or geolocation tools to expose protesters, witnesses, or live positions; public availability does not remove privacy and legal duties.

title: Geo Data Tool
summary: Tool review centered on a crucial limitation: IP geolocation normally indicates an approximate network point or server, not a person's precise physical location.
relevance: Adds an explicit anti-overclaiming record for IP-based inference, including VPN, proxy, NAT, CDN, dynamic-allocation, and database-error risks.
verification_notes: Live Bellingcat toolkit entry verified the described method, limitations, privacy considerations, and warnings about stale or overconfident attribution.

technical_profile.geographic_resolution: Approximate and provider-dependent; often network or administrative registration rather than device location
technical_profile.temporal_resolution: Lookup time must be recorded because allocation and ownership change
validation_requirements: Timestamp the lookup and compare ownership history, routing, hostnames, independent databases, VPN/CDN context, and the relationship between address and subject.
limitations: VPNs, proxies, NAT, CDNs, dynamic allocation, registration location, and database error make person-level or precise-location conclusions unsafe.
An IP lookup is a lead, not identity or precise-location proof; rejected explanations and lookup time should be retained.

safety_profile.display_note: IP addresses can be personal data; publication can create misidentification, harassment, or blacklisting when ownership or context changes.
